title: schrodinger-figure widget params
description: Bespoke widget shape for the schrodinger-equation topic. Each section's interactive is an anonymous (idless) <div class="widget"> with a structured .hd header (title + optional hint) followed by a verbatim middle (zero or more <div class="row"> blocks containing sliders / buttons / spans) and a single <svg> + readout pair. The middle's markup variants (slider+span, slider+span+button, three buttons, two slider rows, no row at all) are too varied to share with parametric-plot or button-stepper without creeping their schemas, and the schrodinger widgets are unique on the page (no other topic uses idless widget wrappers in this exact shape), so the body lives in `bodyMarkup` as an artifact string. The driving IIFE is captured verbatim in `bodyScript`. Portable consumers (React / SSR) read `title`, `hint`, `svg`, `readoutId`, and the parsed-but-not-shipped controls from a future structured field; for the vanilla-HTML site, byte-identity is preserved by emitting `bodyMarkup` and `bodyScript` directly.

widgetId.description: Optional DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper. When omitted, no id attribute is emitted (matches the schrodinger-equation source which uses anonymous widget divs).

title.description: Header title rendered inside .hd > .ttl, and the default text inside the SVG's <title> child.

svg.description: Primary SVG host. The renderer emits <svg id=... viewBox=... width=... height=...><title>...</title></svg> after `bodyMarkup`'s pre-svg rows but before the readout. Setting svg.titleText overrides the default of widget.title.

titleText.description: Override for the <title> element's text content. Defaults to the widget's `title` when omitted.

readoutId.description: DOM id for the trailing <div class="readout"> companion.

readoutInitial.description: Initial inner HTML of the readout <div>. Defaults to '' (empty) — the schrodinger source's convention is that the IIFE writes the readout at startup so the initial markup is empty.

bodyMarkup.x-artifact: row inner-HTML is widget-specific (sliders + spans + buttons in irregular orderings); portable consumers should structure their own controls from a future `controls` field rather than parsing this string
